name: get_pipeline_trace
description: Returns recent fact-lifecycle traces from the live renderer. Use it to locate data that entered the pipeline but was not routed or deliberately dropped.

parameters.domain: string (optional) — Restrict traces to one domain.
parameters.stalledOnly: boolean (optional, default false) — Only return entries older than ten minutes without a routed or dropped terminal event.
parameters.limit: number (optional, 1-100, default 25) — Maximum number of newest matching traces.
